appropriate: a tilted seed with a curled sprout and two small dot eyes reads at once as a small friendly pip, Caregiver-soft; the reading-with-you half of the idea is not visible, nor does it need to be
distinctive: avoids books, owls and big-eyed animals, but a rounded blob with two dot eyes is a familiar kids'-app character type and sits near Reading Eggs' egg mascot in silhouette
simple: one rounded seed body, one curled stem, two dots; drawable from memory in seconds
legible: the seed-and-stem silhouette holds down the ladder to 16 px though the eyes merge away below 24 px; the bold rounded 'Pip' reads at a glance in every lockup and the nav bars
adaptable: black, reversed, both one-colour panels, the coral app tile, the browser tab and the avatar all work unchanged; the springy stem suggests a motion logic but none is drawn
timeless: a mascot where warmth is the strategy (a 'use' item); the rounded chunky type is a 'use carefully' Smokies style that the strategy's rounded-sans target justifies
universal: mirrored reads clean; rotated 90 turns the seed and stem into a tadpole or mouse with a tail, and the coral fill can hint at a drop, a faint secondary reading
clear: unsearched: two-dot-eyed blob and seed characters are common in children's apps and Pip and Tim already uses a Pip character; no exact look-alike known to me
congruent: round shape, warm coral hue at medium saturation, small eyes well under a tenth of the body, open frame, a small quick mark for 'Pip'; but tilt plus the off-axis stem are two asymmetries where one was the target, and the solid body runs heavier than medium
system: horizontal lockup, symbol tiers 256 to 16, one-colour 64 and 32, app icon, tab favicon, avatar and card are all drawn cleanly; no stacked lockup shown
